problem_type: Portal Escape propagation cancels the owning canvas selection
symptom: PR 825 Linux smoke loses the composer when Escape reaches React Flow; the initial capture fix instead swallows inner input Escape before its own handler can clear or cancel editing
direct_cause: Document bubble is later than React Flow, while unconditional document capture is earlier than the inner target: neither respects the required target -> popover -> ancestor order
class_root: Popover Escape ownership must respect event target scope and child handling, not choose one global event phase for every focus position
affected_population: All AnchoredPopover consumers embedded in keyboard-interactive ancestors; focus on a trigger, menu button or input
entry_points: Effects picker on a selected React Flow node
Storyboard parameter overflow and asset pickers using the shared portal
internal_only_reason: The application owns portal dismissal. Inspected installed @xyflow/react NodeWrapper.onKeyDown and React portal event behavior in a real Chromium fixture; no external API is changed.
invariants: One Escape closes the current owning popover without changing the ancestor canvas selection
A higher popup or dialog receives Escape first; composition and already-prevented events do not dismiss the popover
Inside controls receive Escape first; preventDefault or stopPropagation keeps their owning popover open without deselecting its canvas node

door_reduction.why_not: The props owner and design-lab, assets, storyboard, node effects, project sync and timeline callers each represent a distinct surface. Their dismissal already converges on AnchoredPopover; preserve these callers and fix that single boundary. Door list generated by node scripts/door-map.mjs src/design/AnchoredPopover.tsx.

generality_proof: Every caller shares one dismissal policy. Events inside the portal reach child handlers and then the portal React bubble boundary before ancestors; events outside it use document capture before React Flow. Both paths share popup/dialog/composition precedence.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Preserve child-first Escape handling, then consume unclaimed Escape before ancestor keyboard handlers, yielding to higher overlays

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Effect picker uses AnchoredPopover with close callback restoring trigger focus; CI and Chromium reproduce lost selection
Parameter overflow uses the same portal with nested selectors; existing popup precedence retained
Wrapper forwards its onClose directly to AnchoredPopover; no independent key handler

recurrence.reason: Any caller inside an ancestor keyboard handler can receive the same Escape; not limited to Linux or image geometry
same_class_scan: Read NodeEffectChips, ShotComposerBar, AssetPickerPopover and shared overlayLayers; inspected React Flow NodeWrapper Escape handling
2026-09-20 re-ran door-map (same seven doors); actual React and native input handlers reproduce the unconditional capture regression

prevention.invariant: Child controls own Escape before the popover, and the popover owns unclaimed Escape before keyboard-interactive ancestors
prevention.failure_mode: Inside prevented/stopped events do not dismiss the popover; other eligible Escape closes only this popover; higher overlays and composition still take precedence
prevention.strategy: One shared dismissal callback; document capture routes only events outside the portal, while the portal React bubble boundary handles internal events after their targets and stops Escape before React Flow

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove the unconditional document capture behavior and former document bubble close; scope routing converges on one dismissal callback, with no caller-specific or alternate policy

dependency_lifecycle.current: Installed @xyflow/react NodeWrapper and React 18 portal bubbling
dependency_lifecycle.target: Keep current pinned runtimes with application-owned popover Escape boundary
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: React Flow correctly owns Escape for the node itself; a package upgrade cannot decide application overlay ownership
exit_criteria: On a React or React Flow upgrade, run the real browser focus matrix and Electron smoke; change the boundary only if the upstream event contract changes

migration: No stored data changes; all existing callers inherit the shared handler
residual_risks: Local Chromium and macOS Electron validation does not replace rerunning the failing Linux CI lane

invariant_owner_layer.why: Every affected caller shares this portal; test the actual production component inside actual React Flow, not a copied handler
